// what this is: Scripts under `tools/` that no automated pass reaches, each with the reason. `check-tools` point 4 refuses a cold script that is not named here, and refuses an entry here for a script a pass does reach — an excuse nobody removed reads like a fact.
// how reached is decided: The command of a target the push line or the schedule invokes, then the closure over `./*.mjs` imports. A module a running gate imports is as exercised as the gate: `restore-dictionaries.mjs` was listed here until the closure was written and the gate refused the entry.
// at-pass.mjs: Drives a live screen reader on a display of its own. No runner in this workspace has one, and the reading is a person's to take (plan 2.2). `at-pass.yml` dispatches the other two readers by hand.
// release.mjs: Stages the package on npm. `release.yml` runs it by hand, and nothing on a push or a schedule reaches it — deliberate, and also the risk: the instrument of a release is the one no gate exercises, so its dry run is the rehearsal, and the tag is the proof (decision 0079).
// changelog-renderer.mjs: Renders the CHANGELOG entry for `nx release` (decision 0079). `release.mjs` is its one caller, through `nx.json`, and nothing on a push or a schedule reaches that — the same reason `release.mjs` stands here.
